props.title: My Gear
props.text: The tools behind the image. Every camera, lens, and light is chosen with intention — because the right gear disappears and lets the story lead.

props.subtitle: Philosophy
props.title: The right tool for every story
props.text: I don't believe in a one-size-fits-all kit. A run-and-gun documentary calls for a different setup than a controlled studio shoot. I choose my gear based on the story, the environment, and the emotion we're chasing — not brand loyalty or spec sheets.

props.subtitle: Kit
props.title: What I shoot with
props.text: A curated selection of cinema-grade tools for every stage of production.

items.title: Cameras
items.text: RED V-Raptor, ARRI Alexa Mini, Sony FX6 — each chosen for different production scales and creative demands.

items.title: Lenses
items.text: Cooke S4/i Primes, Canon CN-E Primes, Sigma Art Series — from soft and organic to sharp and clinical.

items.title: Lighting
items.text: ARRI SkyPanel S60, Aputure 600d Pro, Astera Titan Tubes — precise control for any mood or environment.

items.title: Audio
items.text: Sennheiser MKH 416, Sound Devices MixPre-6 II, DPA 4017 — clean, reliable sound capture on every set.

items.title: Stabilization
items.text: DJI Ronin 4D, Steadicam M-1, Dana Dolly — smooth motion from handheld to dolly and everything in between.

items.title: Monitors & Wireless
items.text: SmallHD Cine 13, Teradek Bolt 4K, full DIT station — accurate monitoring and real-time review on set.

props.subtitle: Approach
props.title: Gear follows the story
props.text: Every project starts with a conversation about tone, mood, and visual language — not a gear list. The camera package, lighting plan, and support equipment are all shaped by what the story needs. Whether it's a stripped-down two-person doc crew or a full commercial package with a DIT tent, I scale the kit to serve the project, never the other way around.

props.title: Let's plan your shoot
props.text: Have a project in mind? Let's talk about the right approach and the right tools to bring it to life.

meta.title: Gear — Marcus Cole
meta.description: The cameras, lenses, lighting, and tools Marcus Cole uses for cinematography and filmmaking. Cinema-grade equipment for every production.
